about: Every IDSPG variable sorted into input / optimisation / fixed / dependent. 'cad_variables' are the 198 variables IDSPG writes to CADs/IDSPG/idspg_equations_onshape.txt (and the same names to idspg_equations.txt), in that order, under the stage prefixes a1_ / a2_; 36 of them are written twice under both prefixes, and the second name is marked 'alias_of' the first (same value, same classification). 'code_only' are values the code uses but does not write to the CAD file, plus every config key the CAD does not use; 'unused_config_blocks' are config blocks IDSPG never reads. tests/test_variable_categories.py checks the lists against the code and re-evaluates every formula and lookup; docs/variables/idspg.md is generated from this file (python tools/variables/render.py).

categories.input: chosen parts and material: the motor's dimensions and torque, the motor driver's mount dimensions, the gear material's allowable stress
categories.optimisation: searched by the optimiser: teeth, module, number of planets
categories.fixed: constants that don't depend on the design: clearances, wall thicknesses, fastener and bearing choices, feature sizes, the gear standard
categories.dependent: computed from the variables above, by a formula, a catalogue lookup (bearings, bolts, nuts) or a rule the code applies (the tooth-stress rule for face widths)

confidence.high: the code reads it directly from one source, or computes it with an explicit formula
confidence.medium: the code is clear, but the category is a judgement call (see the reason)
confidence.low: can't be decided from the code alone

cad_variables.name: a1_ring_gear_relation
cad_variables.formula: Stator_height + a1_ring_gear_thickness_mounting_casing - bearing_retainer_thickness - a1_bearing_height - a1_carrier_bearing_step_width - a1_clearance_planet - a1_fw_r - a1_clearance_planet * 0.5
cad_variables.reason: axial-fill check for stage 1: the stator height and mounting casing less the stage-1 stack (a value written for the CAD, not used by the code)

cad_variables.name: a2_ring_gear_relation
cad_variables.formula: a1_fw_s_used + a1_standard_clearance_1_5mm + a1_carrier_bearing_step_width + a1_bearing_height + a1_fw_s_used2 - a2_fw_p - Stator_height - a1_ring_gear_thickness_mounting_casing - rotor_bottom_thickness - motor_stator_extrusion_depth
cad_variables.reason: axial-fill check for stage 2: the two stage lengths less the stator, rotor base and extrusion (a value written for the CAD, not used by the code)

code_only.name: motor_peak_torque
code_only.reason: motor torque the gears are sized for (peak torque under the default rating setting); sets the face widths

code_only.name: gear_allowable_stress
code_only.reason: allowable tooth stress of the gear material, chosen with the material mode (3dp: PLA, metal: steel); sets the face widths

code_only.name: FOS
code_only.reason: factor of safety in the tooth-stress rule

code_only.name: serviceFactor
code_only.reason: service factor on the motor torque in the tooth-stress rule

code_only.name: planet_bearing_gap
code_only.reason: axial gap between the two planet bearings (one in each planet gear); with the bearing width it sets the smallest planet and ring width of both stages; one key for both stages (decided 2026-10-31)

code_only.name: sun_hub_clearance_multiple
code_only.reason: margin around the sun hub's bolt circle, in multiples of standard_clearance_1_5mm (5); used for the stage-1 sun hub (CAD and stage-1 mass code); one shared key name across the gearbox types

code_only.name: maxGearboxDiameter
code_only.reason: largest gearbox diameter the optimiser may use (gearbox_runner max_diameter): the motor's outer diameter plus two clearances, times a factor

code_only.name: maxGearboxDiameter_Stg1
code_only.reason: largest stage-1 diameter the optimiser may use (gearbox_runner max_diameter_stage1): the stator bore less two ring walls
